site: Three months earlier · Company training pool
black: R-One, Tide Control. Our first watch together.
establish: Deck clear, connectors dry. I have the tether.
unlock: R-One, pool clear. Arm thrusters. I'll fly with you.
approach: See A on the north wall? Ease towards it.
descend: A is four metres down. Descend until the plate is centred.
coast: Hands off. Watch the plate and the depth reading.
hold: R-One, depth is changing. Engage depth hold to steady the shot.
trim: Log the depth. Steady first, shutter second.
A: North wall, plate A, four metres deep. Close in, frame and shoot.
B: Plenty of tether. Turn to the east wall for B, same depth.
C: Last plate, C on the south wall. Then I'll reel in.
again: R-One, do you copy? Take that last step at your pace.
report: Logged {n}/3 usable photos. Remember your framing distance.
miss: Logged for practice. Move to the next station.
